title: Nurikabe Canonical Representation
description: Rectangular grid where some cells contain a positive integer clue. Each clue seeds a white island of that size; the remaining cells form a single connected black sea with no 2x2 pools.

cells.description: m x n grid of integers. 0 = empty cell, any positive integer = an island clue placed in that cell (the island containing this cell must have exactly that many white cells).
